==Description==
The '''Moderator''' was an unreleased tower that was in the game before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]].

Not all information is available about the '''Moderator'''. It was a tower similar to the [[Scout]] and based on the limited information available on it, would have likely been an early to mid-game tower. It would have fired at enemies with its luger pistol.
